suppress.notes: False positive: Google-maintained com.google.android artifacts are CPE-matched against unrelated products sharing the "android" name; Android platform CVEs do not apply to these Maven libraries
False positive: AndroidX artifacts are CPE-matched against Android OS CVEs; androidx.* are app-side support libraries, not the platform the CVEs describe

False positive: the app ships the actively maintained mwiede JSch fork (com.github.mwiede:jsch), but CPE matching misattributes it as cpe:/a:jcraft:jsch and reports CVEs for the abandoned com.jcraft 0.1.x line; the fork patched them (e.g. Terrapin CVE-2023-48795 fixed in 0.2.15, we pin 2.27.x)
